name: Genmitsu Cubiko
notes: Price from the official German store de.sainsmart.com (tax included, regular price). The international store sainsmart.com currently lists it at USD 349 (sale, regular USD 499), also with an EU-plug variant. Launched via Kickstarter. Controls via PC (GRBL-compatible, e.g. Candle/UGS), Genmitsu app or built-in panel; USB/Wi-Fi; 32-bit MCU. Auto Z-probing with height-map auto-leveling for PCB milling; door interlock; approx. 60 dB with enclosure closed. Laser (5.5 W) and drawing modules sold separately; polishing module announced. Feed = max speed. Linear guides (round rods) taken from official product images.

accessories.name: CFL55-33 5.5 W Laser Module
accessories.description: 5.5 W compressed-spot 445 nm diode laser module designed for the Cubiko and 3018/3020 series, no external power supply needed.

accessories.name: CNC Drawing Robot / Pen Plotter Module
accessories.description: Pen-holder attachment that turns the Cubiko into a drawing and handwriting machine.

accessories.name: Cubiko 4th Axis Rotary Attachment
accessories.description: Rotary module with 42HS48 stepper, 4:1 reduction and chuck for stock up to 40 mm diameter; not in the EU store, listed at USD 149 (pre-order, ETD October) on sainsmart.com.
